highlights: Deceptively spacious two double bedroom home in a highly sought-after village location
Spacious living/dining room with multi-fuel stove and separate kitchen/dining room
Block-paved driveway providing off-road parking for two vehicles
Low-maintenance enclosed rear garden with attached workshop/storage space
16-panel solar PV system with air source heat pump central heating
summary: Located in the heart of this popular village, easily accessible to both Penrith and Carlisle, with a strong community and sought after village primary school, a well presented, 2 double bedroomed, semi-detached / end link family home, with enclosed garden, ideal as a first time buy, or buy to let.
description:
Presented in well maintained order throughout, this deceptively spacious modern home offers an outstanding opportunity to purchase a low-maintenance property in one of the area's most sought-after villages, ideally positioned for easy access to Penrith to the south and Carlisle to the north.

Perfect for first-time buyers, downsizers or those seeking an easy-to-manage home, the accommodation is well planned and comprises from the front an entrance porch which opens into the living/dining room, featuring a multi-fuel stove set on a slate hearth, creating an attractive focal point. To the rear, the kitchen/dining room provides ample space for everyday living and leads through to a rear hall with access to the garden and stairs rising to the first floor.

Upstairs, there are two generous double bedrooms, positioned to the front and rear, together with a well-appointed four-piece family bathroom.

Outside, the property enjoys block-paved off-road parking for two vehicles to the front. The enclosed rear garden has been designed with ease of maintenance in mind, offering an attractive outdoor space alongside an attached workshop providing excellent storage or hobby space.

A particularly noteworthy feature is the 16-panel solar PV system, which generates an income in the region of £1,500 per annum which covers the majority of the running costs of the recently installed air source heat pump.

Combining modern efficiency, generous accommodation and an excellent village location, this is a home that is sure to attract strong interest. Early viewing is highly recommended.

Directions From Penrith town centre follow the A6 northwards for approximately 4 miles. Turn left into the village, Beckside is on the left approximately 200 meters past the village school.

Services Mains electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested. Air source electric central heating with solar panels.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. • There is private off road vehicle parking. • Neighbours have a right of way across the garden to the rear.
